featured.title: What Kids Wish Their Parents Knew About Fun
featured.guide: 11 岁女孩 Mila Rojas 观察到：大人早就忘了「纯粹为了好玩」是什么感觉。这篇演讲很短，话题完美对应雅思口语 Part 1 的「童年/游戏」话题。

points.example: 纯粹为了好玩。I played basketball just for fun, not for competition.
长大得太快。Kids these days are growing up too fast.
全身心投入。When you're with your kids, be present, don't check your phone.

featured.title: Do All My Friends Secretly Hate Me?
featured.guide: 成年人交朋友为什么这么难？Corner Piece 用幽默的方式拆解社交焦虑——这就是雅思口语 Part 3「友谊/社交」话题的绝佳素材。

points.example: 暗地里讨厌我。I keep thinking my friends secretly hate me.
成年后交朋友。Making friends as an adult is so hard.
不可能完成的任务。Keeping in touch with old friends feels like mission impossible.

featured.title: "I perfected deception": My Secret Life as a Relapsed Alcoholic
featured.guide: 一个戒酒成功又复发的人的真实自述。写得极其坦诚，词汇丰富，适合积累「意志力/健康/个人经历」类话题的高级表达。

points.example: 复发（尤指恶习）。He relapsed after six months sober.
欺骗、瞒骗。She lived a life of deception for years.
跌到谷底。I hit rock bottom before I asked for help.
